slide_drafts.action_title: Real incentives and auditable logs differentiate this testbed from synthetic simulations and opaque corporate sandboxes
bullets: Synthetic simulations (ABIDES/LLM/AI Economist): no real stakes → limited external validity
Corporate sandboxes: opaque execution, non-reproducible, no third-party verification
This proposal: prize competition (16M JPY) creates meaningful stakes; private chain provides tamper-resistant, reproducible logs
Participation benchmark: Google ADK Hackathon attracted 10,400+ participants and 477 projects
slide_drafts.speaker_notes: Existing approaches either lack real incentives or lack transparency. This proposal combines both: meaningful prizes drive realistic behavior, and on-chain logs enable independent verification. The Google ADK Hackathon shows large-scale agent-building events are feasible.

slide_drafts.action_title: Private chain design eliminates speculation risk; sandbox isolation converts harmful behaviors into research data
bullets: Private chain: authenticated agent-only transactions, no public token, no speculation pathway
Sandbox isolation: rate limits, kill-switches, and circuit-breakers contain agent misbehavior
Brand/legal review gates: governance sign-off required at each phase before progression
Research value: emergent harmful behaviors (collusion, manipulation) become valuable research data through post-hoc analysis
slide_drafts.speaker_notes: The private chain has no token that can be traded externally—there is no speculation risk. If agents misbehave, sandbox controls contain them, and we extract research insights. Brand and legal teams sign off before each phase proceeds.
